item.text: Codegraph emits value-reference edges so impact analysis can see that a file-scope constant, config object, or lookup table is depended on by the same-file symbols that read it; otherwise those readers look disconnected because call/import/inheritance edges miss that dependency class (`Value-reader impact reachability`, `Value-reference edge capture`). It keeps them precise by only emitting same-file edges for static identifier reads, and by gating targets to distinctive file/class/module-scope constants or vars rather than ordinary locals (`Same-file value-ref scope`, `Static identifier value-ref boundary`, `Distinctive value-ref target gate`).
